nodes.name: counter_style_descriptors.toml
nodes.summary: Defines the descriptors for the CSS @counter-style rule, specifying Rust types for system, negative, prefix, suffix, range, pad, fallback, symbols, additive-symbols, and speak-as descriptors.

nodes.name: font_face_descriptors.toml
nodes.summary: Defines the descriptors for the CSS @font-face rule, specifying Rust types for font-family, src, font-style, font-weight, font-stretch, font-display, unicode-range, font-feature-settings, font-variation-settings, and override descriptors.

nodes.name: longhands.toml
nodes.summary: Defines all CSS longhand properties with their Rust types, initial values, style struct assignments, spec URLs, and engine-specific configuration for the Servo/Stylo build system's code generator.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains 429 CSS property definitions processed by the build system to generate the Rust property module code. Each section specifies the property's Rust type, style struct membership, engine support (gecko/servo), animation behavior, and vendor prefixes.
